text: In this world, your shadow says what you're really thinking.
Out loud.
You see, shadows can't lie. And the bigger the shadow, the louder it gets.
My dog's shadow just yells squirrel!
And Mom loves my drawings. Her shadow says... it's a potato.
Me? I keep my shadow tiny. I stay out of the light.
Kids call me Vampire Nubi.
Because my shadow has one big secret.
Lily.
Then one day, Brayden pushed me onto the talent show stage.
Right under the biggest spotlight in school.
My shadow was ten feet tall. And Lily was in the front row.
Subscribe, because my shadow just took a deep breath.
I covered it with my hoodie. It peeked out.
I turned off the lights. The emergency lights turned on.
Then the spotlight hit Brayden, and his shadow said...
I still sleep with a teddy bear named Mister Snuggles.
speaker: brayden-shadow

text: Everyone gasped. Brayden turned bright red.
That's when I realized something. Shadows only say what you hide.
So I stopped hiding.
I grabbed the mic and said it myself. Lily, I like you.
speaker: nubi

text: My shadow just shrugged. Yeah, what he said.
speaker: nubi-shadow

text: Then Lily's shadow whispered... finally.
speaker: lily-shadow

text: Now we walk in the sun together. Our shadows hold hands.
